notes: The letter is addressed to Deligne from Lodève. The day 27 is clear; the remaining date is obscured and not fixed using H’s editorial reference to another copy.

The author describes being prevented from teaching a first-cycle course in the first trimester, with the cause wording uncertain, and considers a small algebra seminar about Mme Sinh’s fourbis, possibly in the context of “champs”. This is a content account only, not a supplied expansion of damaged words.
The author explicitly writes “qui pour l’instant reste heuristique” and “il doit y avoir un triangle distingué canonique”. These qualify the proposed construction; no proof is written on this page.

The mathematical data are two abelian sheaves M and N on a topos X, a truncated derived underlined Hom expression named E(M,N), a two-row list of invariants, and a three-object triangle. The exponent uncertainties and overwritten word remain local ink uncertainties.

The sideways note addresses Breen, asks what he thinks, and is signed P. [Deligne]. It is a distinct, finer hand. Its spelling neamoins/neanmoins and unaccented repondre are preserved instead of modernised.

The distinction between i and j in the second H exponent prompted special visual inspection because the nearby condition uses i. That nearby condition was not permitted to determine the exponent. No mathematical validity check or proof check was performed.

The copied sheet has dark vertical and horizontal edge impressions and short isolated dark edge marks; these are not transcribed as characters. No secure author page number, extra insertion, independent drawing, or cancellation of the whole letter is present. The pencil 61 is an archive comment only.

coverage: Read the complete 1687 × 2361 source once for layout, then each supplied full-resolution half once in order. Compared every body line, date, salutation, all words of the separate sideways note, both equations, every underline, exponent, index, bracket and arrow in the triangle with C and H. Examined tight enlarged crops only for sites left unresolved by those halves; each was generated once with source-pixel coordinates, LANCZOS enlargement to 2800 pixels, autocontrast, contrast and sharpening logged in crops.jsonl, and the sideways sites were rotated 90 degrees clockwise. C doubt sites were all resolved or explicitly retained. H omits the overwritten earlier term and replaces readable à la place with an unreadable marker, adds si before the formula, uses a plain R and varies note punctuation and placement. No additional body block was found. No other readers, pages, OCR, web source or external transcription was consulted, and no LaTeX compilation was performed.
